d:
A pipeline explosion accident occurred in Muzaffarpur during drain construction.
SDM (East) Anand Utsav says, "According to the information received, a leak in the gas pipeline led to an explosion, resulting in damage. We are currently investigating the incident, and relief and rescue operations are underway. Three people have been reported as seriously injured and are currently undergoing treatment. We cannot provide official confirmation on deaths yet. A drain construction project was underway, and the damage occurred during excavation work by a JCB machine..."
